result.summary: The image depicts a narrow residential street with a marked zebra crosswalk and sidewalks on both sides. While the narrow geometry likely encourages lower speeds, the presence of parked cars near the crossing creates significant visual obstructions for both pedestrians and drivers.

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles on both sides of the street near the crosswalk obstruct the sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both curbs near the foreground crosswalk

hazards.name: Lack of traffic control
hazards.description: There are no stop signs or signals to regulate traffic at the marked crosswalk, relying entirely on driver yielding behavior.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve visibility for all road users.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) to shorten the crossing distance and place pedestrians in a more visible position before they enter the travel lane.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Signage
interventions.description: Install high-visibility pedestrian crossing signs to alert drivers to the presence of the crosswalk.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a marked zebra crosswalk and a wide, well-maintained sidewalk with a curb ramp. However, the crossing lacks active signals or warning signs for drivers, and the area under the elevated structure may present visibility challenges due to shadows and pillars.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signage
hazards.description: There are no signs alerting drivers to the presence of the crosswalk, which may lead to low driver yielding rates.
hazards.location_in_image: At the approach to the crosswalk on the left and right sides.

hazards.name: Reduced Visibility
hazards.description: The crossing leads into a shaded area under an elevated highway structure, where pillars and shadows may obscure pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: The background area under the elevated roadway structure.

interventions.title: Install Pedestrian Crossing Signs
interventions.description: Add high-visibility pedestrian crossing signs (W11-2) to alert approaching drivers of the crossing location.

interventions.title: Enhanced Lighting
interventions.description: Improve lighting under the elevated structure to ensure pedestrians are clearly visible to drivers at all times of day.

result.summary: The image shows an urban street with sidewalks on both sides and residential row houses on the right. While the environment includes street trees and lighting, it lacks marked crosswalks and has significant visual obstructions due to continuous curbside parking.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along both sides of the street significantly limit the visibility of pedestrians to approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both curbsides throughout the street view.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crosswalks
hazards.description: The absence of painted crosswalks at the intersection reduces driver awareness of potential pedestrian crossings.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility (continental) crosswalk markings to clearly delineate pedestrian crossing areas.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions at the intersection to shorten crossing distances and improve pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Implement parking restrictions near the intersection to ensure clear sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The image shows a narrow residential street with continental-style crosswalks and sidewalks on both sides. While the low-speed environment and marked crossings are positive, the sidewalk is obstructed by trash bags and there is a lack of formal traffic control signs at the intersection.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: Large black trash bags are piled on the sidewalk, forcing pedestrians to navigate around them or into the street.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image on the sidewalk next to the black fence.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the narrow street may block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians entering the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Down the street in the center of the frame.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve visibility for both pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Stop Sign Installation
interventions.description: Install a stop sign to formalize the right-of-way at the intersection and ensure vehicles come to a complete stop before the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Waste Management Enforcement
interventions.description: Ensure sidewalks are kept clear of debris and trash bags to maintain a continuous accessible path.
